story_title: Five suites, one pool, the whole group under one roof.
story_lead: Welcome to Soul Moon Villa — a bold and spacious designer villa tucked away in a peaceful pocket of Umalas, just moments from the energy of Canggu. Thoughtfully curated down to the smallest detail, this modern two-story residence invites you to unwind, connect, and feel truly at home.
story_points: 5 ensuite bedrooms, king beds, private dressing rooms, for up to 10 guests
L-shaped pool with kids' shallow end, sunken lounge, rooftop terrace, 1,200 m² of garden
Double-height living room with projector cinema, 12-seat dining, full kitchen
Umalas, a quiet pocket minutes from Canggu's beaches, cafés and beach clubs
book_lead: Rates include staff, daily housekeeping and airport transfers. Minimum three nights; five over Christmas and New Year.
gap_source: Source: PriceLabs market data, Canggu, 4–10 BR villas (350 listings), pulled 2026-09-11: market occupancy by month for October, November, December (1–20); annual average 44%. The Christmas and New Year peak is excluded, not counted as low season (Christmas and New Year from the 21st: market occupancy +16% and prices +14 to +18% vs surrounding dates (PriceLabs)).
cta_title: Your low season, filled. 10% on the nights we sell, nothing else.
cta_text: Fifteen minutes on WhatsApp to walk through the numbers for your villa. We take a handful of villas per area for the low season.
